justification: Changes when a production monitor runs and how it reports a block. Not Critical: no data written differently. Not Minor: production scheduling and error path.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a 403 retries through a browser or is not named, or if the loop stops waiting for Sydney after hours.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: PCO email 2026-04-22: scripts must run outside Sydney business hours; allow-list confirmed for 209.71.97.10 on 2026-07-02.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutating the 403 message made the 403 test fail (1 failed).

pre_impl.existing_data: run_loop.sh ran immediately on every start; a restart at 05:44 UTC ran it in business hours.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Code and docs still named 149.28.176.81, the retired Railway copy; check_ip.py on Fly prints 209.71.97.10.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new files; one function removed (browser fallback, now unused).
pre_impl.external_source_error: A PCO 403 now raises a named RuntimeError instead of an ImportError from the missing browser.

functions.name: _fetch_nsw_legislation_version_http
functions.what: Reads an instrument's version date; 403 raises a named block.
functions.input: one legislation.nsw.gov.au instrument page URL to read
functions.if_none: None when no date is on the page, as before
functions.failure_mode: A wrong expected IP in the message would mislead the reader, not the data

functions.name: after_hours
functions.what: True from 19:00 to 03:59 Sydney time, so a run ends well before 06:00
functions.input: the container's system clock read in Sydney time
functions.output: shell exit status zero when a run is allowed
functions.if_none: Without tzdata TZ falls back to UTC; tzdata is installed in the image
functions.failure_mode: A wrong window delays the weekly run, it never writes data

break_it.scenario: Fly restarts the machine at 2pm Sydney
break_it.what_happens: The loop logs 'business hours; waiting' every 30 min and runs at 19:00

break_it.what_happens: Sydney hour reads as UTC and the window is wrong

break_it.scenario: A run starts late in the window
